_comment: Demo/modelled dataset for the SNP-to-Pathways MVP. Fields marked is_modelled=true are NOT real predictions and are labeled as such in the UI. Real-world values (based on public knowledge of these well-known variants) are used where reasonably established; perturbation_factor and edge weights are always modelled. All rsIDs, positions (GRCh38) and SIFT/PolyPhen/ClinVar values were checked against MyVariant.info (dbSNP/dbNSFP/ClinVar) in October 2026.

protein.name: Serine/threonine-protein kinase B-raf
protein.simple_description: This protein is a relay switch inside the cell. When a growth signal arrives at the cell surface, this protein helps pass that signal further down the chain, eventually telling the cell to grow or divide.

functional_effect.note: Well-characterized real-world variant (BRAF V600E, rs113488022). PolyPhen-2 and ClinVar values match MyVariant.info (dbNSFP has no SIFT score for this variant). It INCREASES (not decreases) downstream signalling, which is why perturbation_factor is >1.0; that direction and the 1.8 magnitude are our curated modelling choice, not a database value.

protein.name: GTPase HRas
protein.simple_description: This protein acts like an on/off switch just inside the cell membrane. It gets turned on when a growth signal is received, and passes that 'grow' instruction further down the signalling chain.

functional_effect.note: Real-world variant (HRAS G12S, rs104894229; associated with Costello syndrome). SIFT/PolyPhen/ClinVar values match MyVariant.info. Activating (gain-of-function) direction and the 1.4 magnitude are our curated modelling choice.

protein.name: Platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha
protein.simple_description: This protein sits on the cell surface and acts as the antenna that first receives the growth signal from outside the cell, before passing it inward.

functional_effect.note: Real PDGFRA nonsense variant (R512*, rs866988382). ClinVar lists it as 'Uncertain significance' and there are no SIFT/PolyPhen scores (they only score missense changes). A premature stop codon usually truncates the protein, so perturbation_factor is estimated from the consequence type using our documented heuristic (nonsense -> ~0.15). This is a Modelled Prediction, NOT a database prediction.

protein.name: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1 (MEK1)
protein.simple_description: This protein is another relay point in the signalling chain, passing the growth instruction one step further towards the cell's control center (the nucleus).

functional_effect.note: Real synonymous (silent) variant in MAP2K1 (L115L, rs2140583667); ClinVar: 'Likely benign'. SIFT/PolyPhen do not score synonymous changes. The amino acid does not change, so protein function is expected to be almost unaffected. Included as a 'low impact' control example to contrast against demo-001/002/003.
